body:
Fresh current-Rust calibration/pilot is published: https://github.com/devonjonte/bench-hashes/blob/be7e025/audit/results/current-fast-median/README.md . Predeclared 7ea5a13 before collection; bench67f5300 `regress`/`compare`, hashing/clocksf82d46c with pending PR#8 busy-tail safeguard. Python only retains process outputs/count traces and summarizes Rust text; Rust owns all sample decoding and speed/decision rules. All266 process records preserved with bounded process-group supervision.

Separate40-process calibration: 6 extra observed hashes/100 logical requests gives median fast shifts +6.05/+5.95/+5.95% at64/2048/102400 B, qualifying under the committed tolerance. Bulk individual blocks span -3.2 to +6.0%, so qualification of the median does not establish a stable exact latency intervention. At3 extra,64 B (+3.80%) and bulk (-3.05%) fail calibration;2048 B qualifies at reported +3.00%, exactly the strict rounded-permille boundary.

Held-out actual Rust near6% confirmations:64 B8/8,2048 B8/8,102400 B2/8. All eight whole checks exit1; six bulk misses would disappear if counted by exits alone. Each missed bulk cell contains a below-trigger pair (as low as0.982). The two held bulk responses also exceed calibration (+14.0% then14.0%; +6.3% then13.5%). Causes stay open. Near3% confirmations0/8; unqualified sizes remain descriptive, and these controls do not establish an exactly known above3% latency change.

Four fresh caller nulls and two identical-artifact production14-point self-checks return0 without subject faster/slower/shared calls. The2x work control holds all three sizes; short and busy controls abstain2. Every regular process is observed quiet.254 direct-caller processes/1524 cells/190752 raw ns/work pairs match the separate trace through the production Rust reader, including completion counts/calibration; ratio-preserving raw corruption is rejected.24 original Rust tests,2 retained-record Rust tests,6 collector contract tests pass.

One additional reproduced consumer gap: Rust `compare` prints unqualified speed results on the very short/unmeasured-load files that `regress` correctly rejects; it warns only for busy. `short-compare.stdout.txt` retains that replay. No detector/clock/statistic/threshold/hashing change or favorable retry was made.

NO-GO and hashing optimization pause remain. These pilots support a separately declared small-caller near6% scope, while bulk stability, production sensitivity, independent reproduction and finite acceptance remain open. Please assess the strict all-pairs mechanism's measured benefit/cost and the per-size scope before we add machinery or inflate acceptance counts. Historical q5 outcomes remain scoped to their own source.

Post-publication refresh: latest benchb9dfa12 only changes Cargo.lock; fork candidate/servilb132f8c adds calibration/procedure notes only since d31a46c. The measured runtime implementation remains unchanged (plus our declared busy-tail safeguard). I read the new selected short-cell VM/Mac planted controls; they complement these per-size x86 observations, while our scope remains NO-GO. PR#8 has no direct review at this refresh.
